Additionally, the door handle on the left car appears fused to the body panel without a proper gap or cast shadow (severity 2), and the front wheel arch shows minor geometric clipping/inconsistency (severity 2). These are classic generative artifacts that undermine physical plausibility despite the overall aesthetic appeal.
